title: MRR SkepticalChallenge
description: docs/spec/01_SYSTEM_SPEC.md section 4.8 ('Stage 8 -- Skepticism and independent verification'), MRR-FR-074: 'The skeptic MUST search for counterevidence, alternative explanations, scope leakage, and hidden assumptions.' Fourth task of Epic E4 (task-packets/E4-T04.yaml); the fifteenth entity schema in this repository. A SkepticalChallenge is ONE skeptical challenge raised against a target Claim -- challenge_type is a CLOSED four-value enum, exactly MRR-FR-074's four kinds, in MRR-FR-074's own order. It pins the claim it targets by reference (target_claim_id + target_claim_hash, the claim's own content_hash pinned at challenge time) rather than embedding the claim, mirroring model-invocation.schema.json's own 'references a ModelProfile by id and pinned content hash rather than embedding one' precedent; the same by-reference pattern is applied a second time for producing_model_profile_id/producing_model_profile_hash, the ModelProfile that produced this challenge -- recording independence LINEAGE, never COMPUTING it (that stays mrr.domain.independence, E3-T05, wired by the verifier, E4-T05). PROPOSAL-ONLY, NEVER A VERDICT (MRR-FR-070, AGENTS.md rule 7): this schema declares no verdict/decision/verified/resolved/claim_status property of any kind, anywhere -- the skeptic issues no verification decision and changes no claim's status; that is the verifier's job (E4-T05, out of this task's scope). supporting_source_ids is not a docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md-given field -- this task's own minimal, necessary addition (plain URNs of cited source objects, e.g. SourceRecord/EvidenceAnchor), flagged as an open specification question in this task's PR body, mirroring evidence-anchor.schema.json's own 'anchor_unavailable_reason: not a specification-given field' precedent; not required (a challenge may cite no source), defaulting to an empty array.

challenge_type.description: MRR-FR-074's exact four challenge kinds -- a closed enum, no fifth value accepted.

target_claim_hash.description: The targeted Claim's own content_hash, pinned at challenge time.

statement.description: The challenge itself: the counterevidence, alternative explanation, scope leakage, or hidden assumption being raised against the targeted claim.

rationale.description: Why this challenge applies to the targeted claim.

supporting_source_ids.description: URNs of SourceRecord/EvidenceAnchor (or other) objects cited in support of this challenge. Not a specification-given vocabulary -- this task's own minimal addition; an empty array (the default) means no source is cited.

producing_model_profile_id.description: The ModelProfile that produced this challenge -- independence lineage RECORDED here, never computed (see mrr.domain.independence, E3-T05, wired by the verifier, E4-T05).

producing_model_profile_hash.description: The producing ModelProfile's own content_hash, pinned at challenge time.
